summary: Iter42 — Liturgy DAYTIME (Little Hours: Terce/Sext/None) + VIRTUS feature suite tested end-to-end. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_virtus_daytime.py covering: (a) /api/liturgy now lists [lauds, daytime, vespers, compline]; (b) /api/liturgy/daytime — psalms_vary_by_day=false, section_count_per_day=10, identical sections across weekdays, free user can read; (c) Virtus catalogue 401 anon / 200 auth with exactly 9 items + user_is_premium + is_admin flags; (d) Virtus content endpoints return correct shape (what_is, life_stages{singleness,dating,marriage}, overcoming_vice, saints) with resources EXCLUDED, and saints-of-virtue returns intro + saints_by_virtue[]; (e) /api/virtues/{slug}/resources is 402 for free, 200 for admin/premium; (f) admin gating: PUT/regenerate/admin all 403 for free and 200 for admin, PUT persists what_is and sets edited=true; (g) Plan CRUD: empty slugs→400, create plan with patience+humility/10days→200 with 6 goals (2 do + 1 refrain per virtue) + total/completed/active, list, toggle (flips done + updates completed), unknown goal 404, delete + 404 after. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Home shows virtus-home-card (Journal preview removed). virtus-home-open/explore navigates to /virtus hub which renders virtus-plan-builder with all chips, virtus-card-{slug} list, and existing plan rows. Tapping virtus-card-humility loads virtus-detail-humility with AI content; admin sees virtus-edit-btn → virtus-edit-screen with editable fields + virtus-edit-save. Free user does NOT see virtus-edit-btn and sees a lock icon + virtus-resources-unlock CTA instead of expanded resources. Liturgy hub shows new liturgy-tile-daytime; opening it loads liturgy-reader-daytime with 10 sections AND the weekday selector is correctly HIDDEN (verified liturgy-day-monday absent). Plan creation flow from the hub (patience + 14 days) successfully calls AI, navigates to virtus-plan-screen, and renders the 3 checkable goals (2 do + 1 refrain).
action_items: (non-blocking) The virtus-resources-toggle Pressable in /app/frontend/app/virtus/[slug].tsx is rendered for ALL users (renders a lock icon + the unlock CTA for free users); this matches the product spec but a test that asserts 'no virtus-resources-toggle for free users' would fail. Suggest documenting that the testID is intentionally always present; differentiation is by adjacent virtus-resources-unlock (free) vs virtus-resource-0..N (premium expanded).

(non-blocking) PUT /api/virtues/{slug} test left 'humility.what_is' overwritten with the test marker. The testing agent ran POST /api/virtues/humility/regenerate (one ~52s LLM call) before frontend tests so the UI showed real content. If main agent wants a clean baseline, re-run regenerate.

(non-blocking) Several deprecation warnings in console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking, but should be cleaned up app-wide (not specific to this iteration's new files).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/virtues.py is well-structured (553 lines): /plans declared before /{slug} to avoid route capture, MongoDB _id excluded via projection, EditContentRequest is partial-update friendly with explicit 'nothing to update' 400 guard, goals get UUIDs, plan.active derived from end_date >= today.

/app/backend/liturgy_of_hours.py Daytime block correctly sets psalms_vary_by_day=false and the section_payload helper falls back to 'sunday' for fixed-psalter hours so any day_key returns the same 10 sections.
Resources are correctly NOT in the public /api/virtues/{slug} payload; users must call /resources which is wrapped by require_premium — clean separation.

Frontend /app/frontend/app/virtus/[slug].tsx correctly conditions both the edit pencil (admin-only) and the resources body (premium-only) on the server-supplied flags. Good defense-in-depth alongside the 402/403 backend gates.
Plan creation in /app/frontend/app/virtus/index.tsx ignores selected.size === 0 client-side AND backend returns 400 for empty virtue_slugs — both layers guard the invariant.
